newsitem.title: USA: Bellwether Cove Field well test a success.
newsitem.headline: Bellwether Cove Field well test a success.

text.p: Bellwether Exploration Co said on Monday its well in the Cove Field, off the coast of Texas, tested at a rate of 1.6 million cubic feet of gas per day.
The oil and gas exploration and production company said this was its second successful Cove Field well.

Bellwether said it had a 90 percent working interest in the five producing wells in the Cove Field, including State Lease 57686 No. 12 Well. The remaining 10 percent stake was privately-held, it said.

The Cove Field production platform now averages about 13 million cubic feet of gas per day, up from 1.5 million cubic feet per day in January 1996. The Cove-McPac Gas Unit No. 1 Well, in which Bellwether owns a 42 percent working interest, would be connected to the platform by December 1, it said.
